policy: glass is a faithful extraction of ../ags-bar/style.css; border-w is the 1.5px panel/frame border and hairline-w is the 1px card/control/badge hairline, so there is no border-width deviation
nonvisual: border-w = 1.5 is the outer .settings-surface frame (style.css:163); hairline-w = 1 is the card/control/badge hairline (style.css:183/:428/:433/:442/:559/:761)
.settings-net has border: none and emits no margin-bottom or min-height (row height and list spacing are TSX-owned; style.css:378-387)
layout tokens panel-width, bt-list-spacing, bar-row-height and chip-min are not expanded into CSS; they remain manifest/skin.json values for skinValue()
box-shadow: none and backdrop-filter: none from the shadow/blur tokens (the source has no declaration)
font-family: inherit on the window root (the source inherits without a declaration; no font-size is emitted)
